text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock C and Stock E at losses, then bought Stock E again at a higher price; I should avoid impulsive trades and have a clear reason before changing a position.","I added to Stocks A and B after buying them earlier, so I should check how much of my account is concentrated in each stock before adding more.","My account value fell from 102,214 to 94,853 over these periods; I should focus on a consistent plan for my ten-year goal rather than chasing quick gains."]}
